(NEWS10) — The Schuylerville football team is bound for the state semifinals for the third year in a row following a 34-0 victory over Gouverneur Saturday in a NYSPHSAA Class C regional final. items.headline: Shenendehowa girls volleyball wins Class AAA state title in four sets
items.excerpt: Two years ago, the Shenendehowa girls volleyball team looked on in defeat as Fairport celebrated capturing the NYSPHSAA championship in Class AAA. This year, there'd be no runner-up finish for the Mustangs. It was their turn to storm the court at Harding Mazzotti Arena.
